item.text: The data leak comes from both stores holding one global array, and the view reads those arrays before/after loading any share. I’ll store each array under its `shareId`, make every store action target one key, and have the view select the loaded share’s key. The separate invitation cache used elsewhere is a different store and will stay untouched.

The stores now keep independent per-share arrays, and the member view’s email list uses the requested `getExistingEmails` helper. I’ve also set the selected share as soon as the link resolves, so the view switches its selectors before loading member data. Next I’m checking the package typecheck and the existing targeted tests.
